svg.text: sends the message and a 60 s
request guards before any LLM call;
OmniRoute gateway: answer model and eval judge; Groq: intent classifier
OTel spans per turn and tool;
message text off unless switched on
Bajaj public documents and RBI directions
-> chunks -> the Qdrant collections RAG reads
Solid arrow = request path at run time. Dashed = optional, offline or telemetry.
ZEN is the only decision authority; the agent and RAG never decide. All applicant data is synthetic.
